podcast.body: A year after Simon & Garfunkel's original reached number one, Aretha Franklin covered this song as a full-on gospel hymn, fulfilling its destiny. Her version impressively reached a respectable number 6 pop peak on the Hot 100 and brought Paul Simon's composition to number one on the R&B chart. "Impressively, her version not only reached a very respectable number 6 pop peak on the Hot 100, she brought Paul Simon s composition to number 1 on the R&B chart."
